text: User: I am planning a trip to Kyoto in April. I prefer trains over flights, and I want to stay near Gion.
Assistant: Kyoto in April is a good choice for cherry blossoms. Trains from Osaka are frequent, and Gion is walkable.
User: My hotel check-in is April 12, and I need a late checkout on April 15 because my train leaves in the evening.
Assistant: I will note April 12 check-in and April 15 late checkout. The evening train gives you a full last day.
User: I am allergic to peanuts, so please avoid restaurants that serve peanut sauce.
Assistant: Noted, no peanut sauce. I will look for restaurants with clear allergy menus.
User: My friend Maya is joining on April 13, and she is vegetarian.
Assistant: Maya joining April 13, vegetarian meals noted.
